full/posix/vscode/ollama-embed/codex-cli.html: # Keep generated configuration files out of version control. echo .chunkhound.json >> .gitignore # Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and Codex CLI for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/ cat > .chunkhound.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "embedding": { "provider": "openai", "model": "qwen3-embedding", "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1" }, "llm": { "provider": "codex-cli" } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF # Configure VS Code to connect to ChunkHound via MCP. if [ -f .vscode/mcp.json ]; then cat <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' .vscode/mcp.json already exists — merge this block into it manually: { "servers": { "ChunkHound": { "type": "stdio", "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF else mkdir -p .vscode cat > .vscode/mcp.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "servers": { "ChunkHound": { "type": "stdio", "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ] } } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF fi
